source: X public search via Grok Bot x MCP (search_posts_all, get_posts_counts_recent); market: DexScreener, CoinGecko

method.spike_ratio: posts/hour over last ~1.5h (previous full hour + current partial hour) / average posts/hour over the 22 hours before (floor 0.5/h)
method.signal: Pump/Dump label from X spike + hype momentum + DexScreener price change (5m/1h/6h/24h) + buy/sell txn share. PUMP shuru = hype rising, price up, buys >= 52%; Overheated = price already up a lot while hype fades or sells win; DUMP = price falling hard with sells winning; Hype bina price = mentions up, price not moved yet
method.risk: 0-100 (higher = riskier): liquidity size, pair age, FDV/liquidity, sell pressure, volume churn, liquidity concentration, shill/scam patterns, symbol-only match
method.hype_score: 0-100: 45 spike + 25 velocity + 15 author diversity + 15 engagement, minus up to 25 for scam patterns
